name: Airship Android SDK

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always: a Channel ID is created (not linked to the user's identity). Push token collected if push notifications are used. Message Center credentials generated if Message Center is used.
If analytics is enabled: lifecycle events (foreground/background), Message Center message status, notification opt-in status, in-app automation events and push responses (button taps, quick replies).

ask: Do you use Contacts / named users (contact ID linked to the channel)? If you tie it to your user identity, declare Personal info / User IDs.
Do you set attributes with personal info (e.g. first name, email, phone)? Declare the matching Personal info types.
Do you send custom events (e.g. purchases) or screen views? Declare App activity / App interactions and, for purchases, Financial info / Purchase history.
Do you set health/fitness attributes (e.g. favorite workout)? Declare Health and fitness / Fitness info.
Do you use the Chat module (urbanairship-chat)? If yes, declare Messages / Other in-app messages.
Do you use urbanairship-ads-identifier or otherwise send the Advertising ID? Declare it under Device or other IDs and add Advertising or marketing if used for ads.
Do you use urbanairship-location? Airship requests location on the app's behalf but says it does not upload or store coordinates; confirm your own code does not send location.

sources.title: Google Play Data Safety - Airship Docs

notes: Airship publishes a Google Play Data Safety table. Not collected: photos/videos, audio, files, calendar, contacts, web browsing, crash logs, diagnostics. Collection is controllable with Privacy Manager flags (can disable all features). The page does not state sharing, encryption or deletion; treated as a service provider. Purposes are suggestions where the page gives none.
